comments.text: Canadians travel to Lithuania for knee and hip replacement. Far superior  than  having surgery in Canada where we have 2 to 5 year wait times. The after surgery care is superior also.

comments.text: The old castle on the hill, green meadow, so beautiful!

comments.author: @deirdrelewis1454
comments.text: The previous emigration from Lithuania was when the Jewish population left in the 1940s. Many of them settled here in South Africa. I knew some of them, because they were friends with my father.

replies.author: @WhereonEarth4K
replies.text: It’s fascinating to hear about those personal connections and the history that links Lithuania to South Africa.
